# Text

Text with consistent font size, weight, tone, monospace and truncation. Use it for body text, descriptions,
IDs, times and group headings.

**Category**: Primitives · **Common uses**: Secondary text, IDs and paths (`mono`), amounts and times (`numeric`), truncation, group headings (`overline`)

## Import

```ts
import { Text } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Body text, secondary descriptions and faint hints.

```tsx
import { Stack, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={1}>
      <Text>Body text</Text>
      <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
        Secondary description
      </Text>
      <Text tone="tertiary" size="xs">
        Faint hint
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Codes, paths and numbers

Codes and paths use the monospace font; amounts, quantities and times use tabular numbers to align vertically.

```tsx
import { Stack, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function MonoAndNumeric() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={1}>
      <Text mono size="sm">
        PRJ-2026-0042
      </Text>
      <Text numeric>1,234.50</Text>
      <Text as="time" dateTime="2026-11-03" numeric tone="secondary" size="sm">
        2026-11-03 14:20
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

### Overline

```tsx
import { Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Overline() {
  return <Text overline>Quick access</Text>
}
```

## States

### Truncate

Truncated to one line; the full text is shown on hover.

```tsx
import { Stack, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Truncate() {
  const long =
    'Documents/2026 plan/Marketing/Final/Q4 marketing plan - final - approved for external release.pdf'
  return (
    <Stack gap={1}>
      <Text truncate title={long}>
        {long}
      </Text>
      <Text truncate={2} tone="secondary" size="sm">
        Truncating to two lines suits summaries in lists: this is a fairly long description, and
        whatever does not fit in two lines is replaced by an ellipsis, so that all rows of the list
        keep the same height.
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'2xs' \| 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | Font size step: `2xs` 11, `xs` 12, `sm` 13, `md` 14, `lg` 16, `xl` 20 px. | `'md'` | No |
| `weight` | `'regular' \| 'medium' \| 'semibold'` | Font weight step: `regular` for body text, `medium` for emphasis, `semibold` for labels, small headings, figures and key points. | `'regular'` | No |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'accent' \| 'danger' \| 'warning' \| 'success'` | Tone: `primary` for main text, `secondary` for supporting text, `tertiary` for faint hints; the others are semantic colors. | `'primary'` | No |
| `mono` | `boolean` | Monospace font: IDs, code, API names, paths. | — | No |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | Tabular numbers (without changing the font), so that amounts, quantities and times line up vertically. | — | No |
| `truncate` | `boolean \| 2 \| 3` | Truncates overflowing text: `true` for a single line, a number for the maximum number of lines. | — | No |
| `overline` | `boolean` | Overline style for group headings (small, secondary color, wider letter spacing). | — | No |
| `as` | `'span' \| 'p' \| 'div' \| 'label' \| 'time' \| 'strong' \| 'code'` | HTML element to render: `p` for paragraphs, `label` for form labels. | `'span'` | No |
| `htmlFor` | `string` | ID of the associated form control when `as="label"`. | — | No |
| `dateTime` | `string` | Machine-readable time when `as="time"`. | — | No |
| `title` | `string` | Full text shown on mouse hover (often used together with `truncate`). | — | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Text content. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
